answer.rationale: With the line at 94% of committed volume and no buffer, a full switch to the low-cost vendor in 14 days carries real delivery risk despite meeting the 18% mandate on price. Memory c4 shows benchmarking against market rates moved the incumbent on both price and terms, and the low-cost quote is exactly the leverage needed. Negotiating with the incumbent using that quote targets the mandate while preserving the stable integration (c1). If the incumbent cannot meet the cut, switching remains the fallback before expiry. Verifying c4 and c2 to confirm the negotiation outcome and the low-cost vendor's actual track record before committing.
